preregistration.owner_directive: Regime T — Triple-Barrier target redesign with a linear classification baseline
preregistration.decision_class: Exploratory PRE-HACK-only temporal walk-forward classification; no trading or order authorization
preregistration.hypothesis: A volatility-scaled first-touch event target may be more learnable than a fixed-horizon gross-return regression target on the same price-only OHLC features.
preregistration.null_hypothesis: A fixed LogisticRegression baseline does not exceed 55 percent pooled out-of-fold accuracy and does not show meaningful lift over a training-majority baseline.
preregistration.p_hacking_guard: One fixed target definition, one fixed feature set, one fixed model, one fixed walk-forward protocol, and one execution. No threshold sweep, model tuning, fold change, cost change, or selective rerun is authorized by this registration.
preregistration.change_control: This new Regime T experiment is independent of Regime P. G3 and G4.6 files, model definitions, target contracts, and outcomes remain byte-identical and are not edited.

frozen_g3_reference.walk_forward_protocol_source: frozen G3 preregistration; same three fold UTC boundaries and partition spans

target.decision_timing: Decision after the close of bar t; features use closed bars through t only.
target.entry: Open of bar t+1; entry price is fixed before inspecting the t+1 high/low range.

volatility_estimator.name: Wilder_ATR_14_fraction
volatility_estimator.true_range: max(high-low, abs(high-prev_close), abs(low-prev_close)); first row uses high-low because prev_close is unavailable
volatility_estimator.initialization: Arithmetic mean of the first 14 true-range observations
volatility_estimator.availability: Uses OHLC data through t only; no centered windows, backfill, or future observations

barriers.symmetry: Equal positive/negative fractional distance from next-bar open entry
barriers.direction: Long-only event classification: upper-first versus lower-first

time_barrier.expiry_policy: If neither horizontal barrier is touched within 24 bars, label TIMEOUT and exclude it from binary model fitting and accuracy scoring

touch_resolution.same_bar_both_barriers: AMBIGUOUS; exclude from binary model fitting and scoring because OHLC cannot reveal intrabar order
touch_resolution.gap_policy: Evaluate the first eligible future bar high/low against barriers defined from the next-bar open; no synthetic intrabar path is assumed
touch_resolution.tail_policy: Rows without the complete 24-bar future observation window are UNAVAILABLE and excluded

target.labeling_costs: No fee/slippage adjustment is applied to barrier placement or labels; this is a statistical target diagnostic, not an economic trade simulation.

contract: all rolling features are right-aligned and use closed bars through t only
volume is never read as a feature or passed to the estimator
features.scaling: StandardScaler fit independently on each fold's training samples only

walk_forward.purge_rule: A training decision row is eligible only when its full 24-hour target window ends strictly before train_end. A test decision row is eligible only when its full 24-hour target window ends strictly before test_end.
walk_forward.calibration_and_embargo: Preserve original G3 calendar partitions and boundaries; both intervals remain unused by model fitting and test scoring.

evaluation.interpretation_rule: Pooled accuracy strictly greater than 55 percent meets the owner's initial screening threshold, but is exploratory only. Report class imbalance, balanced accuracy, fold dispersion, and majority baseline; accuracy alone is not proof of tradable edge or statistical significance.
